_meta.description: Roadmap data. Edit via scripts/roadmap_cli.py, not by hand. Run its `render` command afterward to update roadmap.html. Fully local, nothing here is ever pushed anywhere.

milestones.name: Knowledge base
milestones.description: memory/ knowledge base: brief, requirements, research per topic, decisions, open questions.
milestones.why: The project is big; every later session starts from it.

milestones.name: Stack decision
milestones.description: Pick the UI framework and shared core from research/stack.md; user approves; hello-world on Android.
milestones.why: Every other milestone depends on it.

milestones.name: Android reader core
milestones.description: Library, import, EPUB + PDF open, reading position, TOC, single/double page, portrait/landscape.
milestones.why: Android first; the smallest app the user can actually read with.

milestones.name: Flip and page modes
milestones.description: Procedural page curl (default), click zones editor, vertical endless scroll, volume keys + invert.
milestones.why: Flip is the default mode and the hardest piece of the reading view.

milestones.name: Themes and typography
milestones.description: OLED/E-ink/Paper/Parchment/Custom in light+dark, brightness, blur; font browser, custom fonts, text styles, i18n; reflow.

milestones.name: Actual book mode
milestones.description: Okuma-style filters: paper texture, book fold, lighting, side pages, book shadow, behind one toggle.
milestones.why: Signature look; builds on the page renderer.

milestones.name: Image filters and colorize
milestones.description: Upscale, saturation, on-device colorize (on demand + auto with background queue), gallery.
milestones.why: Needs the ML runtime; independent of reading core once images are addressable.

milestones.name: Read aloud
milestones.description: System TTS default, downloadable model catalog, API keys, toggle.
milestones.why: Needs text extraction from the reading core.

milestones.name: All formats
milestones.description: MOBI/AZW3, FB2, CBZ/CBR, DjVu, TXT and the rest of research/formats.md.
milestones.why: EPUB/PDF first; the rest after the core is stable.

milestones.name: iOS and desktop
milestones.description: iOS app, Windows/macOS/Linux apps (Rune if chosen).

milestones.name: Release and site
milestones.description: Public GitHub repo, releases with binaries, egebookreader.vercel.app.
milestones.why: Asked for at the end; each remote step needs approval.
